verdict.rationale: Omnirush is clearly a desktop app for working with a coding agent (gh-1, gh-7). Per-chat model selection implies multiple chats, and the agent can create worktrees, which suggests parallel sessions (gh-3, gh-5). Nothing shows a visual diff viewer or side-by-side session layout; the PR reviews in gh-5 are done by the agent via `gh`, not shown as diffs in the UI. Missing for 10: a visual diff review UI, evidence of side-by-side multi-session panes, and hands-on corroboration.
